title: Polyplacophora & Acanthochitonidae 64-species x 17-locus design (PREPRINT-28 dimensions) vs. published class-wide phylogenomics
purpose: End-to-end seqnet -> RuNIE validation sweep at the dataset dimensions of PREPRINT-28 (acanthochitonidae-phylogenomics-preprint): 64 species across 11 Polyplacophora families (emphasizing Acanthochitonidae and Cryptoplacidae) and 17 loci (13 mitochondrial PCGs + 16S rrnL + 12S rrnS + nuclear SSU_18S + LSU_28S), paired with intraspecific COX1 and nuclear 18S/28S/ITS haplotype cluster networks and 12 Bayesian coalescent skylines. PREPRINT-28 sets only the taxon strata and quotas; it is not a validation source. Final trees are scored against deep Polyplacophora suborders, superfamilies, and Acanthochitonina groupings reported in the peer-reviewed studies below. A clade is testable when the run samples >= 2 tips inside and >= 2 outside it, and recovered when the unrooted tree contains the corresponding bipartition.

design_reference.taxon_design: 4 Order Lepidopleurida outgroups (2 Leptochitonidae, 1 Nierstraszellidae, 1 Hanleyidae), 11 Suborder Chitonina (8 Chitonidae, 1 Schizochitonidae, 1 Ischnochitonidae, 1 Chaetopleuridae), 10 basal Acanthochitonina Mopalioidea (8 Mopaliidae, 2 Tonicellidae including valve-buried Cryptochiton stelleri), 5 Cryptoplacidae (4 Cryptoplax, 1 Choneplax), 9 basal/non-Acanthochitona Acanthochitonidae & allies (3 Craspedochiton, 3 Leptoplax, 1 Notoplax, 1 valve-buried Cryptoconchus, 1 valve-reduced Choriplax grayi), 15 Atlantic/Mediterranean/South African/Pan-American Acanthochitona & Americhiton, and 10 Indo-West & NW Pacific crown Acanthochitona.
design_reference.taxonomy_note: Full Polyplacophora mitogenomes encode all 13 mitochondrial PCGs (including atp8) plus rrnL (16S) and rrnS (12S). Nuclear SSU_18S and LSU_28S stabilize deep Paleozoic divergences across Acanthochitonidae and Cryptoplacidae genera lacking complete mitogenomes (e.g., Cryptoplax, Choneplax, Craspedochiton, Leptoplax, Cryptoconchus, Americhiton). The Liolophura sinensis chromosome-level RefSeq assembly (formerly released under L. japonica; corrected in Hong Kong Biodiversity Genomics Consortium 2025, DOI: 10.46471/gigabyte.159) anchors the 48 nuclear CDS orthologs across four biological adaptation families (Ferritins, alpha-Carbonic Anhydrases, HSPA12 chaperones, and single-subfamily CYP3A monooxygenases).
design_reference.locus_interpretation: 15 mitochondrial loci (13 PCGs + rrnL + rrnS) + nuclear SSU_18S + LSU_28S = 17 orthologous phylogenomic loci. Radula magnetite biomineralization (Ferritins), shell-eye/girdle-spicule aragonite biomineralization (alpha-CA), intertidal heat-shock (HSPA12), and benthic allelochemical detox (CYP3A) nuclear CDS families are analyzed separately in Stage 4 codon-selection sweeps.

scored_clades.name: Order Chitonida (Chitonina + Acanthochitonina) relative to Lepidopleurida Outgroup

support.statement: Order Chitonida forms a strongly supported clade sister to basal Order Lepidopleurida
Mitogenomic analyses robustly separate Order Lepidopleurida from monophyletic Chitonida (Chitonina + Acanthochitonina)
Suborder Chitonina forms a monophyletic sister lineage to Suborder Acanthochitonina
Chitonina is recovered as a distinct subordinal clade separate from Acanthochitonina
Suborder Acanthochitonina is monophyletic with shared mitochondrial gene-order hallmarks uniting Mopalioidea and Cryptoplacoidea
Mopalioidea and Cryptoplacoidea robustly unite into monophyletic Acanthochitonina
Cryptoplacoidea unites Acanthochitonidae and Cryptoplacidae by 18 perinotum bristle tufts and reduced articulated valves
Acanthochitonidae, Choriplax grayi, and Cryptoplacidae share a strongly supported common Cryptoplacoidea ancestry derived relative to Mopalioidea
Vermiform Cryptoplacidae forms a distinct derived clade within Cryptoplacoidea
Cryptoplax and Choneplax unite as a specialized crevice-burrowing worm-chiton clade
Mopalioidea forms the basal sister radiation of Acanthochitonina outside Cryptoplacoidea
Katharina, Cryptochiton, Mopalia, Plaxiphora, and allies cluster within Mopalioidea

report_only_clades.name: Acanthochitonidae sensu lato (paraphyly check vs. Cryptoplacidae)
report_only_clades.why_not_scored: Traditional Acanthochitonidae s.l. (Craspedochiton, Leptoplax, Notoplax, Cryptoconchus + Acanthochitona) can test paraphyletic relative to nested Cryptoplacidae or Choriplax/Notoplax assemblages depending on locus sampling (Sigwart2013; Sirenko2017).

report_only_clades.name: Convergent complete dorsal valve burial (Cryptoconchus vs. Cryptochiton)
report_only_clades.why_not_scored: Tested explicitly as convergent independent origins of internal dorsal valve burial in Mopalioidea (Cryptochiton stelleri) vs. Cryptoplacoidea (Cryptoconchus floridanus).
